name: Nythran
notes: Once organic, now cybernetically enhanced beings; underwent controlled, gradual AI integration so organic minds and AI intelligences coexist as equal citizens. Divided into Cyber-Symbiotes (fully merged) and Traditionalists (partially organic). Primary polity: Nythran Ascendancy.

naming_exemption.reason: Species name "Nythran" preserved verbatim from the cited species/civilization codex.

distribution: The organic-descended people of the Nythran Ascendancy. Note the Ascendancy is a polity of TWO peoples — Nythran organics AND AI intelligences as equal citizens; the species is not the whole citizenry.
identity_model_note: Species = a people (biology + broad cultural origin). Membership is not bounded by any single polity/faction; see member_polities (non-exhaustive) and distribution.
